faq_vs_guide.topic: automated backups on DB instance deletion
faq_vs_guide.faq_says: Automated backups are deleted when the DB instance is deleted. Only manually created DB Snapshots are retained after the DB Instance is deleted.
faq_vs_guide.expected_guide_wording: you can choose to retain automated backups when you delete a DB instance (not re-verified by this lens; behavior lens owns it)
faq_vs_guide.action: registrar pairs the two facts in the conflict queue; prose teaches the guide; the FAQ sentence is not used in the quick-fire.

faq_vs_guide.topic: cross-Region read replicas for RDS for SQL Server
faq_vs_guide.faq_says: Yes, Amazon RDS (except RDS for SQL Server) supports cross-region read replicas.
faq_vs_guide.expected_guide_wording: the guide may list RDS for SQL Server among engines with cross-Region read replicas (not re-verified by this lens)
faq_vs_guide.action: behavior lens stores the guide fact; registrar opens or resolves the conflict.

faq_vs_guide.faq_says: do not support Global Databases, Amazon RDS Proxy, cross-Region read replicas, or cascaded read replicas
faq_vs_guide.expected_guide_wording: RDS Proxy and some replica topologies may now be supported (not re-verified by this lens)
faq_vs_guide.action: decisions+changes lens checks the guide; the FAQ fact stays reference-only if the guide differs.

faq_vs_guide.faq_says: baseline of 3 IOPS/GB and ability to burst up to 3,000 IOPS
faq_vs_guide.expected_guide_wording: gp2 baseline per GB with burst; gp3 with a fixed baseline independent of size (numbers lens owns the values)
faq_vs_guide.action: use the guide values in Numbers that decide answers; the FAQ sentence is reference only.

faq_vs_guide.faq_says: No, a Multi-AZ standby cannot serve read requests.
faq_vs_guide.expected_guide_wording: a Multi-AZ DB cluster has two readable standby DB instances
faq_vs_guide.action: not a conflict: the FAQ answer is about the Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Prose and questions must name the deployment type. Product-page fact rds-faq-multiaz-two-readable-standbys-proxy covers the cluster side.

faq_vs_guide.faq_says: Amazon Aurora, Amazon RDS for MySQL, and MariaDB: You can create three tiers of read replicas.
faq_vs_guide.expected_guide_wording: the guide may describe cascading read replicas for RDS for PostgreSQL too (not re-verified)
faq_vs_guide.action: behavior lens; the FAQ fact makes no claim about PostgreSQL.
